teaser.en: A bright hedge flower that even goats won't touch: every part of the plant is poisonous.
teaser.sw: Ua angavu la ua wa nyumba ambalo hata mbuzi hawaligusi: kila sehemu ya mmea huu ina sumu.
teaser.dg: Mmea wa lichigo wenye maruwa ganayoala, ambao hata mbuzi taauguta: chila seemu ya mmea hinyu ina sumu.

summary.en: Mkode is yellow oleander, an ornamental shrub from tropical America grown as a hedge for its trumpet-shaped yellow flowers. Every part of the plant is highly poisonous.
summary.sw: Mkode ni oleanda ya manjano (yellow oleander), kichaka cha mapambo kutoka Amerika ya tropiki kinachopandwa kama ua wa nyumba kwa ajili ya maua yake ya manjano yenye umbo la tarumbeta. Kila sehemu ya mmea ina sumu kali.
summary.dg: *Mkode* ni *yellow oleander*, chitsaka cha kupambira chirichorehwa kula Amerika ya tsi za dzoho, chinachophandwa dza lichigo kpwa sababu ya maruwage ga rangi ya mandano ga umbo ra ndzumari. Chila seemu ya mmea hinyu ina sumu kali sana.

about.en:
*Mkode* is a shrub or small tree, up to about 4 metres, with many stems. Its shiny, narrow leaves are about 10 cm long and grow in spirals around the stem. The flowers are narrow trumpets, usually yellow but sometimes white or salmon, with petals that are twisted in the bud. The fruit is fleshy and four-angled, about 3 cm across, with a flat triangular nut inside.

Pakia counts it among the few plants that Digo speakers identify by their flowers, because they are valued as ornamentals.
about.sw:
*Mkode* ni kichaka au mti mdogo, wenye urefu wa hadi mita 4 hivi, wenye mashina mengi. Majani yake membamba yanayong'aa yana urefu wa karibu sm 10 na huota kwa mzunguko kuzunguka shina. Maua ni tarumbeta nyembamba, kwa kawaida ya manjano lakini wakati mwingine meupe au ya rangi ya samoni, yenye petali zilizosokotwa yakiwa bado matumba. Tunda lina nyama na pembe nne, upana wa karibu sm 3, na ndani yake kuna kokwa bapa yenye pembe tatu.

Pakia anauhesabu miongoni mwa mimea michache ambayo wasemaji wa Kidigo huitambua kwa maua yake, kwa sababu huthaminiwa kama mimea ya mapambo.
about.dg:
*Mkode* ni chitsaka au muhi mdide wa ure wa hadi mita 4 hivi, wenye milita minji. Makodzage ganang'ala, ni membamba, na ure wa sentimita 10 hivi, na ganamera kpwa kuzunguluka kolo. Maruwa ni ndzumari nyembamba, mara nyinji ga rangi ya mandano ela wakati wanjina mereru au ga pinki ya rangi ya chungbwa, na vipande vya maruwa vinabeta ndani ya chimea. Tunda ni ra nyama, ra pembe nne, ra upana wa sentimita 3 hivi, na ndani rina tembe ngumu sambamba ya pembe tahu.

Pakia anautala kahi ya mimea michache ambayo Adigo anaimanya kpwa maruwa, kpwa sababu maruwage ganaonwa kukala na samani ya kupambira.

where.en: It came from Central and South America and is planted across the tropics as a hedge and ornamental bush. It does best on sandy soils, which suits it to the coastal lowlands, where it is a common hedge plant.
where.sw: Ulitoka Amerika ya Kati na Kusini na hupandwa kote katika nchi za tropiki kama ua wa nyumba na kichaka cha mapambo. Hustawi zaidi kwenye udongo wa mchanga, jambo linaloufanya ufae nyanda za chini za pwani, ambako ni mmea wa kawaida wa ua wa nyumba.
where.dg: Asiliye ni Amerika ya Kahi na Amerika ya Kusini, na unaphandwa kosi tsi za dzoho dza lichigo na chitsaka cha kupambira. Unamera chinono sana kpwenye tsi ya mtsanga, kpwa hivyo unafwaha tsi za photsi za pwani, ambapho ni mmea wa lichigo unaophahikana sana.

uses.en: It is grown for its flowers, for shade and as a live fence. ICRAF records medicinal use of the seed, and a heart drug has been extracted from its nuts commercially. But all parts of the plant are poisonous, livestock will not eat it, and ICRAF warns people to take care with children around it.
uses.sw: Hupandwa kwa ajili ya maua yake, kivuli na kama uzio hai. ICRAF inarekodi matumizi ya kitiba ya mbegu, na dawa ya moyo imewahi kutolewa kibiashara kutoka kwenye kokwa zake. Lakini sehemu zote za mmea zina sumu, mifugo haiuli, na ICRAF inaonya watu wawe waangalifu na watoto karibu nao.
uses.dg: Unaphandwa kpwa sababu ya maruwage, kpwa pepho, na dza lichigo ra mihi mizima. Chitabu cha ICRAF chinaandika kukala tembeze nkuhumirwa dza dawa, na dawa ya moyo ikatuluzwa kula kpwa tembeze ngumu kpwa biashara. Ela seemu zosi za mmea zina sumu, mifugo taiurya, na ICRAF chinaonya atu arinde ana phephi na mmea hinyu.

names.en: Pakia records *mkode*, with the English names yellow oleander and lucky nut. No Swahili name is given in the sources.
names.sw: Pakia anarekodi *mkode*, pamoja na majina ya Kiingereza *yellow oleander* na *lucky nut*. Hakuna jina la Kiswahili linalotolewa katika vyanzo.
names.dg: Pakia anaandika *mkode*, phamwenga na madzina ga Chingereza *yellow oleander* na *lucky nut*. Takuna dzina ra Chiswahili ririroandikpwa vitabuni.

reason.en: Same family; its name also warns of poison
reason.sw: Familia hiyo hiyo; jina lake pia linaonya juu ya sumu
reason.dg: Wa jamii iyo hiyo; dzinare piya rinaonya kuhusu sumu

reason.sw: Arrow-poison tree, Apocynaceae nyingine yenye sumu
reason.dg: *Utsungu*, muhi wa sumu ya mivi, mmea wanjina wa *Apocynaceae* wenye sumu

reason.en: Desert rose, a poisonous ornamental of the same family
reason.sw: Mwadiga, mmea wa mapambo wenye sumu wa familia hiyo hiyo
reason.dg: *Mwadiga*, *desert rose*, mmea wa kupambira wenye sumu wa jamii iyo hiyo

reason.en: Lantana, also valued for its flowers
reason.sw: Mjasasa, unaothaminiwa pia kwa maua yake
reason.dg: *Mjasasa*, ambao piya maruwage ganaonwa kukala na samani
